what: The time pharmadelta serves for its second agent: one entry per agent created on a stopwatch, each with the record of the clock that timed it (milestones/M07/README.md). The clock starts at the agent repository's `created_at` and stops at the `completed_at` of the `deploy-agent` job of agentkeel's deploy workflow for the agent's merge commit, both GitHub's records, never a person's. A time in this file is a measured result only when `clock` holds those records and the CI run that read them.
first_agent: label-impact, agentkeel-studio/label-impact, created 2026-10-10 at M01 and not timed (milestones/M01/README.md)
company: The second agent belongs to a fictional bank with no name. It is not the fictional generics company of the other pages, it is not a real bank, and its table and its policy clauses are invented (SPEC/00 §2, P8). It says what the bank's own retention policy requires; it gives no legal or financial advice.
